stationId.description: Must match the station that currently owns the active claim on the Pack task. Must be non-empty: the API treats "" as a missing field and rejects it with 400.

contents.description: SKUs scanned for this package. An empty or omitted array is accepted by request validation (it's well-formed JSON) but rejected by the domain with a 422, since sealing requires at least one scanned item.

items.description: A null item is accepted and treated as an empty SKU string (Go's JSON decoding cannot distinguish them).
